en.name: Armarouge
en.description: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

attacks.name: Boundless Power
attacks.effect: During your next turn, this Pokémon can’t attack.

fr.name: Carmadura
fr.description: Il a évolué grâce à l’armure d’une illustre âme guerrière. Ce Pokémon est extrêmement loyal.

attacks.name: Puissance Illimitée
attacks.effect: Pendant votre prochain tour, ce Pokémon ne peut pas attaquer.

es.name: Armarouge
es.description: Evolucionó al portar la armadura de un guerrero de renombre. Este Pokémon destaca por su gran lealtad.

attacks.name: Poder Ilimitado

it.name: Armarouge

attacks.name: Potere Incontenibile

de.name: Crimanzo

attacks.name: Unbegrenzte Kraft

pt-br.name: Armarouge

attacks.name: Poder Ilimitado

zh-tw.name: 紅蓮鎧騎
zh-tw.description: 藉由立下眾多戰績的戰士所穿的鎧甲進化成的樣子。是忠心耿耿的寶可夢。
